notes: all-MiniLM-L6-v2 is English-trained. Persian/Arabic-script utterances are intentionally routed to Dina's safe Persian rules. The volume_level node selects levels 1-10 directly from semantic choices; only OTHER_EXPLICIT_VALUE uses deterministic value parsing.

choices.description: The user asks for the current local clock time.
The user asks for today's calendar date.
The user wants to control media volume or sound level.
examples: Set the volume to fifty percent.

choices.description: The user wants to control screen brightness.
The user asks a general question or wants conversation rather than a device command.
examples: Can you help me understand this?

audio.prompt: Choose the requested audio or volume operation.

choices.description: Increase or turn up the media volume.
Decrease or turn down the media volume.
Set media volume to a specific level from one to ten, or to an explicit percentage/value.
examples: Set volume to level five out of ten.

choices.description: Mute or silence the media audio.
Unmute or restore the media audio.

display.prompt: Choose the requested screen brightness operation.

choices.description: Increase or brighten the screen.
Decrease or dim the screen.
Set screen brightness to a specific target percentage.
examples: Set the screen brightness to 30 percent.

volume_level.prompt: For a set-volume request, choose the exact requested level from one to ten. Choose OTHER_EXPLICIT_VALUE for percentages or explicit values outside this one-to-ten scale.

choices.description: Set media volume to level 1 on a scale from one to ten.
examples: Set volume to level 1 out of ten.
Set the volume to 1 on a scale of ten.
